senses.gloss: (b. h.;Saf. of רע, v. רֵעַ, רָעַע) to join, add.—Part. pass. שָׂרוּעַ abnormally long, esp. one that has one hip larger than the other.

senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be stretched, to stretch one’s self.
